attributes.action: Make It A Legal Requirement For Remote Schooling in 30°+ Heat
attributes.background:
My petition is about the safety of children in schools in extreme and humid temperatures.
Many children faint and feel unwell during school when the temperature is unbearable.
The school uniform is dark coloured and traps the heat under the clothing causing excessive sweating.
We want it better.

rejection.details:
You may wish to sign the following petition, which calls for similar action:

Legislate a statutory maximum temperature for classrooms and fund school cooling
https://petition.parliament.uk/petitions/774023
